# BetterHvNote 0.2.0

[ab57d0e] chore: remove erroneously committed diagnostic information

[48a1358] fix(ci): remove references to deleted script tests
    
    Stop invoking the removed release-tag and full-changelog test scripts from CI and release preparation so both workflows can proceed to their maintained validation and build steps.

[cecd083] ci(release): publish a generated full changelog
    
    Build FULL_CHANGELOG.md from published product tags while preserving commit subjects and bodies, excluding sign-off trailers and prior generated changelog commits.
    
    Regenerate and push the document after releases, expose it through the repository ignore rules, and seed the tracked changelog from the existing BetterHvNote and NoteLink releases.

[8b3074b] feat(phone): import shared images and PDFs
    
    Accept single and multiple image or PDF shares, classify each stream from its provider MIME type with an intent fallback, and enqueue the matching transfer item.
    
    Keep text payload support and add unit plus instrumented coverage for external share and export actions.

[97e0d12] feat(export): queue jobs with diagnostics and retry controls
    
    Run export generation through a cancellable queue, report stage-specific progress and outcomes, retain detailed failure diagnostics, and expose explicit generate, retry, and cancel actions.
    
    Discover NoteLink clients at send time with permission handling, serialize the latest notebook state before export, and add JVM plus device workflow coverage.

[06d2358] feat(editor): streamline insertion and in-app feedback
    
    Route image and text insertion through one automatic source decision, preserve explicit local and NoteLink choices, and cover permission-aware entry behavior.
    
    Replace snackbars and the dedicated update banner with reusable e-ink notifications. Validate new-notebook canvas and template compatibility before creation and surface creation failures.

[a1e6e42] feat(ink): align strokes with ROM width geometry
    
    Treat the vendor callback scalar as a normalized stroke-width ratio, keep pen configuration stable for each gesture, and use transactional stroke modeling with whole-stroke raw fallback.
    
    Render the same swept-disc geometry in the editor, thumbnails, eraser hit testing, and PDF exports. Add pressure diagnostics, parity artifacts, and regression coverage for modeling, persistence, and geometry.
